messages:
Nina H.: Quick ask — launch board wants a tiny "play-by-play" for SEO + redirects for the webinar landing. Core goals: preserve attribution, prevent param duplicates, ensure event rich result. Keep it short so Ops can action.

Cal (Growth): TL;DR rules:
• canonical tag on all param variants -> point to clean landing URL
• app/nginx 301s from old vanity -> canonical; do NOT drop querystring (we need UTMs)
• include only canonical URLs in sitemap; bump priority for the launch window and ping Search Console

Arun S.: Technical notes: for edge/CDN rewrites confirm querystring passthrough. Example nginx: 
```
rewrite ^/vanity$ /webinar/clean-url permanent;
```
That preserves ?utm_* automatically. For express-based redirects do res.redirect(301, target + req.url.slice(req.path.length)).

Marta - Content: On content side I'll: consolidate three drafts into one canonical page, add Event JSON-LD with performer and ISO8601 startDate, and craft OG tags. Also will add clear internal links from blog + docs to the canonical.

seo-lint-bot: scan finding: Event schema missing organizer.name and attendanceMode recommended for virtual events. startDate must be full ISO8601 with timezone.

Cal (Growth): JSON-LD example for copy team: 
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Product Webinar","startDate":"2024-06-10T16:00:00Z","attendanceMode":"https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar"},"performer":[{"@type":"Person","name":"Sasha R."}],"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}

Arun S.: Inbound routing: set a first-touch cookie with utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id (30d). On form submit read cookie server-side and POST hidden fields to SFDC. Also add a fallback to use query params if cookie missing.

Marta - Content: Also recommend not adding hreflang unless we have localized content; adding it incorrectly confuses crawlers. We'll also ensure staging domains have X-Robots-Tag: noindex.

Nina H.: Owners & deadlines:
- Arun: redirect snippets + checklist (nginx & app examples), verify CDN passthrough (owner Arun) — due tomorrow EOD
- Marta: merge content, inject JSON-LD & OG, update internal links (owner Marta) — due in 48h
- Cal: spec cookie + SFDC mapping, coordinate with Sales Ops, propose A/B (UTM-in-url vs cookie-only) (owner Cal) — due tomorrow AM
- Infra: submit sitemap update + Search Console reindex after deploy (owner Infra) — on deploy

seo-lint-bot: scheduled re-scan 12h after PR merge; will report schema or canonical mismatches.

Cal (Growth): I'll add a 6-point checklist row to the launch board: canonical, 301 preserve params, sitemap update, JSON-LD present, cookie wired, Search Console request. Ping me if CDN blocks querystrings.

Nina H.: Great — keep thread updated with PR links. Thanks! :sparkles:
